title: Exhaustion of W ∩ U by compactly contained open sets (parent step 12)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^P, let U, W ⊆ ℝ^P be open with μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0, and let m ∈ [0, ∞]. Suppose μ(W') ≤ m for every open W' with W' ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContained W' U: closure W' is compact and contained in U) and W' ⊆ W. Then μ(W) ≤ m.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (m : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → IsOpen W → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ W' : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W' → CompactlyContained W' U → W' ⊆ W → μ W' ≤ m) → μ W ≤ m
